kevin: quick heads-up — saw a 6% tail latency regression on TP 8x runs for long sequences (>=2048). traces point to all-reduce stalls around certain layers. not sure if it's nccl or our packing logic.
sophia: can you paste the nsys summary? is it before or after the kv-cache change we rolled yesterday? :thinking:
kevin: after — kv-cache prefix optimization landed in latest runtime build. perf-ci reported regression: tp-8x-2k-tail +6.3% this morning.
perf-ci: detected regression: job=tp-8x-2k, metric=tail_latency, delta=+6.3%, baseline=112ms, current=119ms
aar on: linking the nsys flame (trimmed):
```
# nsys summary
GPU activities: all-reduce ops spike at 12.3s and 12.9s, gaps ~60-80us
CPU->GPU memcpy: overlapped but serialization increases at layer 18
Allreduce size: 1.2MB typical per step for KV chunking size=256KB
```
kevin: the gaps line up with when we switch kernel variant (fp16->int8 quant path). suspect message fragmentation into many small NCCL ops when chunking crosses boundary.
sophia: interesting — on ring topology small messages can be bad. tree/allreduce algorithms differ in startup vs transfer slope. did we change msg packing recently?
kevin: yes: batching heuristics now try to cap per-tensor bytes to 256KB to reduce memory pressure. that means some tensors get split 3 ways during TP all-reduce.
aar on: timeline from profiler: layer 17 all-reduce starts, sends 3 nccl ops sized 90KB, 90KB, 1.05MB. first two small ops cause kernel launch overhead and prevent overlap with compute.
sophia: can we try switching NCCL algorithm to tree for these sizes? tree reduces latency for many small msgs, ring better for steady big streams.
kevin: tried quick local: set NCCL_ALGO=tree + NCCL_MIN_NBITS=16384. tail improved ~3-4ms but overall throughput slightly lower. need more runs.
nj: curious if kv-cache prefix/cache hits changed the timing — more cache hits => more uneven tensor sizes across ranks?
kevin: yes, because prefix caching makes some ranks short-circuit earlier, causing imbalance in comm start times. that amplifies the penalty of small-fragment all-reduces.
sophia: plan: 1) run ablation toggling packing cap 256KB -> 512KB, 2) test NCCL_ALGO=ring vs tree with identical packing, 3) add fine-grained timing probes around kv cache path to see rank skew. I'll run on staging 8xA100.
kevin: also adding a quick fix option in runtime to coalesce small tensors before all-reduce (best-effort merge within layer). cheap to implement as a patch.
aar on: sounds good. i can own the coalescing patch, will prototype today.
sophia: great. assign perf-ci job to rerun nightly with both knobs toggled. tagging @kevin @aaron. :thumbsup:
perf-ci: scheduled regression job: tp-8x-2k-coalesce-test, runs nightly at 03:00 UTC
kevin: thanks — will follow up with flamegraphs and cc trace once we have first run. if tree consistently helps we may default to tree for <512KB per-rank messages.
sophia: agreed. also add a metric for "allreduce fragments per step" so we can alert if fragmentation increases after future changes.
kevin: noted. I'll post updates in this thread.
